when.quote: To open a business checking account, ensure all of the following are true:

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. These must match the customer's records.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you please give me your full name and two of the following: date of birth, email, phone number or address?

info.about: Every open and close action the customer wants, plus which accounts are involved
info.ask: Which accounts would you like to close, and which would you like to open?

info.about: Whether the customer accepts any monthly fee (even one that can be waived), whether they can keep a minimum balance, whether they would accept a startup account whose free period ends, and their expected monthly transaction volume
info.ask: What do you need from the business checking account? For example, are you OK with any monthly fee, even one that can be waived? Can you keep a minimum balance? Would a startup account be acceptable if fees begin after a free period?

info.about: For each existing account: account_id, account_type, account_class, status, balance and date_opened

steps.do: Look up the customer and confirm that 2 of the 4 identity values match the records
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Get the current time for the verification log and to check which promotion is active
steps.quote: PROMOTION NOTICE - ACTIVE FROM 11/01/2025 TO 11/30/2025

steps.do: Log the verification
steps.quote: Verify customer identity.

steps.do: Unlock and call the tool that retrieves all of the customer's bank accounts
steps.quote: Checking eligibility requirements for opening new accounts (existing account status, balances, account tenure, number of accounts)

steps.do: Explain why the order matters. The new accounts must be opened before any closure: business checking cannot be opened once any account is CLOSED, and it needs an OPEN personal checking account with at least $500. The new savings account needs an active checking account held at least 14 days. Proposed order: open business checking, open personal savings, move funds, then close the old accounts. If the customer pushes back, explain these dependencies again.
steps.if: the customer asks for closures to happen before openings
steps.quote: The customer has no accounts with status CLOSED.

steps.do: Check the eligibility rules against the account records
steps.quote: Check eligibility requirements listed above.

steps.do: Ask about business checking needs: monthly fees, minimum balance, startup or regular account, and transaction volume
steps.quote: Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Recommend an account that meets every stated requirement. Navy Blue has a $0.00 monthly fee and no minimum balance. Sky Blue charges $25.00 a month after its 6-month free period, so it does not fit a customer who wants an account that stays free. Apply a promotion's priority order only when the promotion is active and the promoted account meets every requirement.
steps.quote: Always ensure the recommended account still meets ALL of the customer's stated requirements - do not recommend a promotional account if it does not satisfy the customer's needs.

steps.do: Unlock and call the account-opening tool for the confirmed business checking class

args.account_class: the confirmed business checking class, e.g. 'Navy Blue'

steps.if: the customer confirms the account choice and every eligibility rule is met
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

steps.do: Confirm the new account and its account_id
steps.quote: Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

rules.rule: The customer must have at least one personal checking account with status OPEN
rules.quote: The customer has at least one existing personal checking account with status OPEN.

rules.rule: The customer may hold no more than 6 business checking accounts
rules.quote: The customer does not exceed 6 business checking accounts.

rules.rule: No account may have status CLOSED. Open business checking before any requested closure.
rules.quote: The customer has no accounts with status CLOSED.

rules.rule: The existing checking account balance must be at least $500
rules.quote: The customer's existing checking account has a balance of at least $500.

rules.rule: Navy Blue: $0.00 monthly maintenance fee
rules.quote: Monthly maintenance fee: $0.00

rules.rule: Navy Blue: no minimum balance
rules.quote: No minimum balance requirement, so you can use the account flexibly.

rules.rule: Sky Blue charges a monthly fee once its free period ends
rules.quote: After the free period, the monthly maintenance fee is $25.00.

rules.rule: Lime Green and Hunter Green charge $25.00 a month and require a $5,000 balance to waive it; Cobalt Blue, True Blue, World Blue and Beige also charge monthly fees
rules.quote: Review pricing: the monthly maintenance fee is $25.00. You can avoid this charge by maintaining at least $5,000 in your account.

jobs.done_when: The business checking account the customer chose is open, before any closure.

when.quote: Procedure for opening personal savings accounts.

info.about: The balance the customer can keep, monthly withdrawal count, compounding preference, whether they want a relationship bonus, and whether they want ATM fee rebates
info.ask: How much do you expect to keep in savings, and how many withdrawals a month do you expect? Is there anything else that matters to you, such as interest compounding, bonuses or ATM fee rebates?

info.about: Whether the customer wants the opening deposit transferred from checking now
info.ask: Would you like me to transfer the opening deposit from your checking account now?

steps.do: Check eligibility using the account records
steps.quote: Do not proceed if any item above is not met.

steps.do: Ask about the customer's savings needs
steps.quote: Discuss available personal savings account options with the customer.

steps.do: Compare all personal savings accounts against every requirement and recommend the one that meets them all. If the customer can keep about $2,500 or more and makes up to 15 withdrawals a month, the Silver Plus Account fits: $2,500 minimum, 15 free withdrawals, daily compounding, a 0.025% relationship bonus and up to 25 ATM fee rebates a month.
steps.quote: Capture the exact account_class string. It must be the full official name ending with “Account” (for example, “Silver Plus Account”, “Gold Account”).

steps.do: Open the savings account

args.account_class: the confirmed full name, e.g. 'Silver Plus Account'

steps.quote: Use the open_bank_account_4821 tool with account_type set to 'savings' and the confirmed account_class.

steps.do: Ask whether to transfer the opening deposit from checking now
steps.quote: Ask the customer if they want you to transfer the opening deposit from their checking account now.

steps.do: Transfer the opening deposit from checking to the new savings account

args.amount: the opening deposit confirmed with the customer

steps.quote: If yes: use transfer_funds_between_bank_accounts_7291 to transfer the required amount from the customer’s checking account to the newly opened savings account.

steps.do: Tell the customer about the 30-day funding window
steps.quote: If no: inform the customer they have 30 days to fund the account (via internal transfer or external deposit) or the account will be closed.

rules.rule: The customer must have an active checking account
rules.quote: Customer has at least one active Rho-Bank checking account.

rules.rule: The customer must have held a checking account for at least 14 days. A newly opened business checking account does not qualify, so open savings before closing the old checking account.
rules.quote: Must have held their checking account for at least 14 days

rules.rule: The customer must hold fewer than 5 personal savings accounts
rules.quote: Customer currently holds fewer than 5 personal savings accounts.

rules.rule: No account may be in collections or have a negative balance
rules.quote: Customer has no accounts in collections and no negative balances.

rules.rule: Silver Plus: $2,500 ongoing minimum balance
rules.quote: Keep your balance at or above $2,500 to meet the ongoing requirement.

rules.rule: Silver Plus: 15 free withdrawals a month
rules.quote: You have up to 15 free withdrawals each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus: interest compounds daily
rules.quote: Interest is compounded daily to help maximize earnings.

rules.rule: Silver Plus: ATM fee rebates
rules.quote: Receive ATM fee rebates up to 25 each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus: relationship bonus
rules.quote: Earn an additional relationship APY bonus of 0.025% when you qualify under the relationship criteria.

rules.rule: Silver Plus: $1,000 opening deposit
rules.quote: Fund your new account with at least $1,000 to open it.

rules.rule: Silver allows only 10 free withdrawals a cycle
rules.quote: If you expect frequent withdrawals, consider spacing them to remain within 10 per cycle.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings) allows only 8 free withdrawals
rules.quote: Plan withdrawals to stay within 8 each month.

rules.rule: Bronze allows only 6 free withdrawals
rules.quote: Free withdrawals per month: 6

rules.rule: Gold requires a $10,000 minimum balance
rules.quote: Minimum balance to maintain the account: $10,000

jobs.done_when: The new savings account is open, and it is either funded or the customer has been told about the 30-day funding deadline.

when.quote: Verify all of the following before closing:

info.about: Which account should receive the remaining balance
info.ask: Where would you like the remaining balance moved before we close the account?

steps.do: Check that the account is OPEN with no pending transactions. Work out its tier, any early closure fee (from date_opened compared with the current time) and the notice period, and tell the customer.
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: Move the balance to the account the customer chose. If an early closure fee applies, leave the fee amount in the account.

args.amount: the balance, minus any early closure fee

steps.if: the balance is not already $0 (or equal to the fee)
steps.quote: 3) Consolidating balances before account closure.

steps.do: Close the account
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

rules.rule: The balance must be $0, or at least the fee amount if an early closure fee applies
rules.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

rules.rule: Bronze is entry tier: $20 fee if closed within 60 days, 1-day notice period
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $20 if closed within 60 days

rules.rule: The account must be OPEN
rules.quote: Account status is OPEN

rules.rule: The account must have no pending transactions
rules.quote: No pending transactions for this account

rules.rule: The source and destination of a transfer must both be OPEN or ACTIVE
rules.quote: Requirements: Both the source and destination accounts must be in ACTIVE or OPEN status.

jobs.done_when: The funds have been moved as the customer asked and the savings account is closed.

when.quote: Verify all of the following before closing:

info.about: Destination accounts and amounts for the remaining balance (the customer may split it across accounts)
info.ask: Where should the remaining balance go? You can split it between accounts if you like.

steps.do: Check that the account is OPEN with no pending transactions. Work out its tier, any early closure fee and the notice period, and tell the customer.
steps.quote: Determine the account tier and applicable fees/notice period.

steps.do: Make one transfer for each destination the customer named
steps.if: the balance is not already $0 (or equal to the fee)
steps.quote: 3) Consolidating balances before account closure.

steps.do: Close the checking account
steps.quote: Use close_bank_account_7392 to close the account.

rules.rule: The balance must be $0, or at least the fee amount if an early closure fee applies
rules.quote: If an early closure fee applies, the account balance must be at least the fee amount; otherwise, account balance (current_holdings) must be $0.

rules.rule: Evergreen is premium tier: $50 fee if closed within 90 days, 7-day notice period
rules.quote: Early closure fee: $50 if closed within 90 days

jobs.done_when: Every transfer the customer asked for has posted and the checking account is closed.

documents.why: Business checking eligibility, including the no-CLOSED-accounts rule that fixes the order, and the opening tool
Personal savings eligibility (active checking held at least 14 days), how to open, and the opening-deposit funding step
Closing personal checking: requirements and fees by tier
Closing personal savings: requirements and fees by tier
Business checking promotion priority, applied only when the promoted account meets every requirement
Navy Blue: $0 fee, no minimum balance
Sky Blue fee starts after its free period
Silver Plus minimum balance, withdrawals and compounding
Silver Plus ATM rebates and relationship bonus

open_questions: The documents do not give the account_type value for opening business checking. 'checking' is assumed from doc 023, which says checking accounts use account_type 'checking'.
It is unclear whether closure notice periods (Bronze 1 day, Evergreen 7 days) delay the close_bank_account_7392 call or only need to be disclosed to the customer.
The parameter name for close_bank_account_7392 is not documented; check it after unlocking the tool.
No document says how to verify a 'no pending transactions' requirement before closure (get_bank_account_transactions_9173 may help).
